reuse.why: Follows the tree's existing guard pattern (ensureBankAccountNotLinked called at each link registration) and adds a sibling guard, though it does not fold the two guards into one shared pre-link check.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule is written once in ensureAccountIsOpen; only the one-line guard call is repeated across the six handler registrations, mirroring the existing guard.

placement.why: The guard and its error constant sit next to ensureBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts and run before any link work, where the tree already enforces link preconditions.

scope.why: Only the new guard, its six call sites and tests.

maintainability.why: Simple and consistent with the existing guard; a new provider must remember two guard calls, which a single combined pre-link check would avoid.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six link handlers go through the new guard alongside the existing one; no shared link helper exists in this tree to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is duplicated beyond the repeated guard call.

one_place.where: ensureAccountIsOpen in server/accounts/app.ts, called by every *-accounts-link handler registration (goCardless, simpleFin, pluggyai, akahu, enableBanking, fintegra).
